notes.title: Crackin' Smackin Patch - Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Crackin‘ Smackin Patch – Version 1.0.8 

Temporary Matchmaking Rework:
We have monitored the number of players over the first few days after the launch and have decided to temporarily remove the separate Matchmaking buttons for Capture the Meat and Free for All. Players weren’t finding games as we split the community into too many different Matchmaking-Systems.

The minimum number of players for Quickmatch has been set to 3. (Was 4 before)

We know these reworks are only a bandaid-fix, but it should help in shortening que times. 

Additional Optimization Pass:
Removed a particularly heavy particle from the Graphics Menu, the FPS-Smoke
Modified a Rendertarget, which drew a lot of resources during the Main Menu

Fixes:
Fixed a Typo in the “Back to Matchmaking”-Button, it said “Back to Machtmaking” before. 
Fixed a text in the Credits
